subject: gk
question:
Match the following neighbouring countries with their official languages correctly.

 

 
 

 **Country Name**
 **Official Language**
 
 

 1. Afghanistan 
 a. Dari
 
 

 2. Bhutan 
 b. Dzongkha
 
 

 3. Pakistan 
 c. Urdu
 
 

 4. Myanmar 
 d. Burmese
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Afghanistan's official language is **Dari**, which is a variety of Persian spoken in Afghanistan.
 
• Bhutan's official language is **Dzongkha**, which is the native language of the Bhutanese people and the national language of Bhutan.
 
• Pakistan's official language is **Urdu**, which is a lingua franca and a symbol of national unity in Pakistan.
 
• Myanmar's official language is **Burmese**, which is the primary language spoken by the Burmese people and the official language of Myanmar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Afghanistan:**

 
 
• Along with Dari, Pashto is also an official language of Afghanistan.
 
• Dari is used as a lingua franca and is the primary language used in the capital, Kabul.
 
 
 
• **Bhutan:**
 
 
• Dzongkha is the language of the Bhutanese people and is used in government and administration.
 
• The language follows the Tibetan script.
 
 
 
• **Pakistan:**
 
 
• Urdu is the national language and one of the two official languages of Pakistan (the other being English).
 
• Urdu is widely spoken and understood throughout Pakistan and serves as a symbol of national unity.
 
 
 
• **Myanmar:**
 
 
• Burmese is the native language of the Bamar people, who are the dominant ethnic group in Myanmar.
 
• Burmese script is derived from the Mon script, which in turn was adapted from the Indian Brahmi script.
